records.name: Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi Vishwavidyalaya
records.description: Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi Vishwavidyalaya (MGAHV) in Wardha is a central university established to promote Hindi globally and foster research in Hindi language, literature, and culture. It offers M.A., M.Phil., and Ph.D. programs in Hindi studies along with certificate courses in Hindi for foreign learners. The university publishes journals, organizes international conferences, and manages a large digital repository of Hindi literature.

records.name: Sangeet Natak Akademi
records.description: Sangeet Natak Akademi is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama, established by the Government of India in 1952 as the apex body for the performing arts. It awards the prestigious Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards, fellowships, and grants to eminent artists and supports regional performing arts organizations across the country. The Akademi also maintains archives of rare recordings and manuscripts related to classical Indian music, dance, and theatrical traditions.

records.name: Faculty of Music and Fine Arts Delhi University
records.description: The Faculty of Music and Fine Arts at Delhi University is one of the oldest and most respected university departments for the study of Indian classical music, dance, and visual arts in India. It offers graduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in Hindustani classical music, bharatanatyam, and visual arts, with distinguished faculty including active performers and Akademi award winners. The faculty is a significant center for musicological research and performing arts scholarship in northern India.

records.name: Bhatkhande Music Institute
records.description: Bhatkhande Music Institute (deemed university) in Lucknow is one of India's oldest and most distinguished institutions for Hindustani classical music, founded in 1926 by Pandit Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande. It offers certificate, diploma, graduate, and postgraduate programs in vocal music, sitar, tabla, sarod, and other classical instruments. The institute has a legendary faculty lineage and has trained generations of prominent Hindustani classical musicians.

records.name: ITC Sangeet Research Academy
records.description: ITC Sangeet Research Academy (SRA) in Kolkata is a unique residential institution for advanced training in Hindustani classical music, entirely funded by ITC Limited as part of India's largest corporate patronage of classical arts. Scholars are selected through a rigorous audition process and trained by masters (Ustads and Pandits) of the Agra, Kirana, Gwalior, and other gharanas over a multi-year residential program. SRA has produced internationally renowned musicians and is considered the benchmark for Guru-Shishya parampara in a modern setting.

records.name: KM Music Conservatory
records.description: KM Music Conservatory in Chennai, founded by internationally acclaimed composer A.R. Rahman, offers contemporary and classical music education with a blend of Indian and Western traditions. It offers undergraduate and diploma programs in music production, composition, performance, and sound design in collaboration with Berklee College of Music. The conservatory is uniquely positioned at the intersection of film music, classical traditions, and modern music production.

records.name: Kalakshetra Foundation
records.description: Kalakshetra Foundation in Chennai is a cultural academy established in 1936 by Rukmini Devi Arundale, dedicated to the revival and propagation of Bharatanatyam and traditional Indian arts. It is a national institution under the Ministry of Culture offering four-year diploma programs in Bharatanatyam, Carnatic vocal music, Veena, and traditional crafts. Kalakshetra is recognized globally as the authority on the Rukmini Devi style of Bharatanatyam and attracts students and scholars from around the world.

records.name: Nalanda Dance Research Centre
records.description: Nalanda Dance Research Centre in Mumbai is a pioneering institution dedicated to the documentation, research, and preservation of classical and folk dance traditions of India. Founded by Dr. Mohan Khokar, it maintains one of India's most comprehensive archives of dance photographs, films, and documents, and provides resources for dance scholars and practitioners. The centre actively publishes research and conducts workshops and seminars on Indian dance history and aesthetics.

records.name: Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan
records.description: Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan is a pan-Indian cultural and educational organization with over 350 centers in India and abroad, offering courses in music, dance, arts, languages, and management studies. Founded in 1938 by K.M. Munshi, it is known for spreading awareness of Indian culture, values, and languages across the world. Bhavan's colleges offer a wide range of vocational and professional programs recognized by state governments and UGC.

records.name: AIIMS (All Campuses)
records.description: AIIMS (All India Institutes of Medical Sciences) are a network of premier autonomous medical colleges under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, with 22 campuses across India led by the original AIIMS New Delhi (established 1956). They offer MBBS, MD, MS, and super-specialty programs and represent the highest tier of medical education and research in India. AIIMS institutions consistently rank at the top of NIRF medical rankings and are the destination of choice for top medical entrance exam rankers.
